simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֹּפֶת (H8611) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: תֹּפֶת (tôpheth) means a smiting , i.e. (figuratively) contempt First listed occurrence: Job 17 6.

definitions.full: H8611. topheth I. תֹּ֫פֶת noun feminine act of spitting ; — absolute וְת ׳לְפָנִים Job 17:6 a spitting in the face do I become, i.e. men spit in my face (|| עַמִּים לִמְשֹׁל ; Perles Baer Bu לִפְנֵיהֶם מֹפֵת ). II. תֹּפֶת see תפת .
